verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.fireflies.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes markdown doc pages. Fireflies also offers a Documentation MCP Server that lets AI tools search and retrieve its docs, and an LLM-development guide with a downloadable file for AI coding tools. missing for 10: no evidence on how complete the llms.txt is (e.g., an llms-full.txt variant) and no independent hands-on report of an agent using these docs successfully.
